text: Direct parity exposed and fixed two JavaFX adapter defects: orthographic plans were rendered through an approximate PerspectiveCamera, and bilateral viewport layout scaled world-space meshes around the origin. JavaFX now uses ParallelCamera with an explicit view-to-pixel viewport transform, retains PerspectiveCamera for perspective plans, and switches mounted SubScenes without geometry or atlas rebuilds.
